name: Agent Info
description: Inspect swarm agents, tools, skills, account vault and state.

function.name: agent_info
function.description: Cross-agent discovery. list gives the swarm roster. get shows enabled tools, skills, account-scoped vault memory and agent state. Use before delegate to find the right tools and workplace.

action.description: list = roster; get = detail for one agent (default get if agent set, else list)

agent.description: Agent id or name for get (defaults to current agent).

include.description: Sections: tools, skills, memory, state, artifacts.
